prompt_fragment:
This asset is UI chrome or ornamentation. Keep it decorative, controlled, and cleanly cuttable from the background.
Keep decorative edges controlled and production-friendly for UI extraction.
raw_description:
A long horizontal ink flourish — central small compass-rose motif
flanked by thin hairline rules that fade to nothing at either end.
Chapter-break feel from a 19th-century atlas.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor horizontal divider on aged vellum parchment, a compass-rose medallion centered between tapering hairline rules, warm vellum cream ground with slate ink linework fading to silence at both edges.

subjects.description: Small eight-point compass rose, fine nib-pen linework, crisp cardinal points with delicate interstitial rays, centered anchor for the composition
Twin tapering ink rules extending left and right from the medallion, pressure-fading to near-invisible at each terminus, atlas chapter-break weight
